system.description:
If a [Mob] has taken at least one point of HP Damage as a result of this damage roll, it becomes [Incapacitated] or [Dead] (your choice).

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special skill that instantly neutralizes the enemy with a flowing attack. Your flash pulls a merciless curtain on the performance of a three-penny actor who stains the stage.
